fullContentHtml:
Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 869 Jailor, Warder Posts - Complete Details

Karnataka Prisons Department has announced the Recruitment 2026 notification for 869 vacancies, including Jailor, Warder posts. The online application process will be conducted from 19 September 2026 to 15 October 2026. Interested candidates can apply online through the official website, cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Online Application Start Date : 19.09.2026
  • Online Application Closing Date : 15.10.2026
  • Fee Payment Closing Date : 16.10.2026
  • Competitive (Written) Examination Date : 21.11.2026, 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM
  • Notification Date : 18.09.2026
  • Online Application Start Date : 19.09.2026
  • Online Application Closing Date : 15.10.2026
  • Fee Payment Closing Date : 16.10.2026
  • Competitive (Written) Examination : 21.11.2026, 3:00 PM – 4:30 PM
  • Kannada Language Test (for candidates required to clear it) : Schedule to be announced later
  • General Merit candidates : 31 years
  • SC / ST / Category-1 / 2A / 2B / 3A / 3B candidates : 33 years
  • Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Category-1, and Ex-Servicemen/Third Gender candidates : ₹500

Application Fee

  • Posts : Jailor, Warder (Vikshakaru), Warder cum Nursing, Second Grade Teacher/Instructor Grade-II
  • Application Fee : ₹750 (General Merit & other categories); ₹500 (SC/ST/Category-1/Ex-Servicemen)
  • Online Application Start Date : 19.09.2026
  • Fee Payment Closing Date : 16.10.2026
  • Online Application Start Date : 19.09.2026
  • Fee Payment Closing Date : 16.10.2026
  • Kannada Language Test (for candidates required to clear it) : Schedule to be announced later
  • PST & Endurance Test : Date, time and venue to be published on KEA/Prisons Dept. website with admit card
  • Post : Minimum Educational Qualification
  • Second Grade Teacher / Instructor Grade-II : Must have passed SSLC or equivalent, AND must hold a Diploma or Certificate in Mechanical/Electrical/Carpentry/Tailoring/Textile/Weaving/Carpet-making, etc., from a Government-recognised institution.
  • General Merit candidates : 31 years
  • SC / ST / Category-1 / 2A / 2B / 3A / 3B candidates : 33 years
  • General Merit and other categories (2A/2B/3A/3B) : ₹750
  • Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Category-1, and Ex-Servicemen/Third Gender candidates : ₹500
  • Post : Subject
  • Warder, Instructor Grade-II, Warder cum Nursing : SSLC-level General Knowledge, Science, Geography, History, Indian Constitution, National Freedom Struggle, Current Affairs & Mental Ability

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
